coverLetter:
Dear Mantel team,

I'm applying for your Senior Software Engineer (Python/React) role because Mantel is where work I'm already doing belongs: GenAI delivery and legacy modernisation for major AU clients, AI-assisted development with human oversight, and a flat Digital team that ships across stacks.

I'm a Melbourne-based senior engineer with production full-stack work since 2018 across banking, health, cruise, and freelance clients. I lead in React and TypeScript with Node, Java/Spring, and REST/SOAP APIs. At CMB I shipped Global Wire Payments (GPOW) in a Wells Fargo context—React SPAs, Node and Spring services, WebSockets for live updates, Jenkins CI/CD, microservices decomposition, and TDD with high unit-test coverage on payment flows. I operated with AWS CloudWatch and Splunk when production issues mattered.

Freelance ownership and LangChain-oriented open source since 2021 match consultancy rotation: ambiguous scope, client-facing delivery, pair programming, and AI tooling I review before merge—the same discipline your posting describes for agentic workflows and AI code security. My Master of Applied AI at Deakin supports Python for AI-adjacent work; I ship strongest in React/Node/Spring daily and deepen Python where clients need it, which your JD explicitly allows. Kong and Apigee are new labels on familiar microservices and OAuth/JWT patterns—I'm ready to ramp on your gateway standards early.

I'm choosing Mantel for structured upskilling, the AI Gateway, and enterprise client breadth. Melbourne hybrid fits me; Sydney travel when projects need it is fine. I'd welcome a conversation with Greg Maratos or the Digital team.

Muhammad Ahmad Naeem
